text:
jordan-sales: Heads-up — MedStream wants a 6-week POC. They asked for a recommended reserved GPU commit, autoscale policy, and whatwe can promise for latency. Workload: mixed chat + embeddings. Steady ~220 rps, spikes to ~1.2k for 8-12min windows. Avg input ~140 tokens. They require VPC peering and SOC2 artifacts. Blockers?

tara-solutions: Nice. Do they have multi-region users? If spikes are regional we can route and only scale in that region. Also need concurrency estimate per session.

jordan-sales: Primary users in NA east/coast; concurrency around 1.8k concurrent chat sessions peak.

sam-eng-runtime: Quick calc: for 140-token average, effective token throughput drives GPU utilization. With our 4-bit quant profile we hit ~300 rps per A100-equivalent GPU for chat generation. For steady 220 rps Id recommend 2 reserved GPUs as minimum safety, but because of bursting and SLA targets youll want a 6-GPU reserved pool + autoscale to 18 for bursts. That avoids relying too heavily on burst credits.

nora-sre: Agree with sam. Operationally we prefer per-AZ minimums: reserved_replicas: 6 across 3 AZs -> 2 per AZ. Also include a warmup cron that runs 3x before biz hours to prefill KV caches.

jordan-sales: Can you share a sample autoscale config I can paste into the quote?

sam-eng-runtime: Sure, keep it simple for the POC: 

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: "2"
  reserved_replicas: "6"   # committed pool for POC
  max_replicas: "18"
  target_rps_per_gpu: "300"
  scale_window: "45s"
  preheat_schedule: "0 8 * * *"  # daily preheat at 08:00
  preheat_runs: "3"
  cooldown: "120s"
  az_spread: "true"
```

tara-solutions: Add a circuit-breaker rule: if queue_depth > 500 for >2m then divert non-critical requests to smaller model variant. Saves GPUs and keeps tail latency OK.

omar-pricing: Pricing implications: 6 reserved GPUs baseline + potential burst up to 12 additional. For the POC we can offer a capped burst-credit allowance (e.g., 9000 burst-minutes) and bill overage at on-demand. I need an estimate of daily burst minutes to finalize numbers.

jordan-sales: Customer says 3-5 burst windows per day, ~10min each during ramp week; later maybe 2 spikes/day. That maps to ~30-50 min/day initially.

sam-eng-runtime: Thats reasonable. With preheat and warm KV, cold starts during spikes should be minimal. Also lock model binary and quant profile in the offer: "model: redwood-clarity-1.1, quant: q4_0" — keeps perf predictable.

helen-security: SOC2 docs OK to share. For VPC peering we'll need their IP lists and an MOU for logging/retention. If they require customer-managed KMS in the POC, we must mark as an enterprise add-on (longer lead time). For now we can enable encrypted logs and sanitized audit samples.

jordan-sales: Legal pushed back: they want a 50p gen latency SLA of 50ms during steady-state. Realistic?

sam-eng-runtime: Not at that token and model size. We can propose: 50p <200ms for embeddings and 50p <300ms for chat as our standard POC targets. If they require 50ms wed need a distilled model and much higher reserved commit + routing priority. Suggest offering a premium SLA option in the quote.

omar-pricing: Will model both: standard SLA (reserve 6 GPUs, capped burst credits) and premium SLA (reserve 12 GPUs, priority scheduling, premium fee).

nora-sre: Operational blockers to call out in the quote:
- need customer IP allowlist for VPC peering
- confirm failover AZ tolerance (cross-AZ traffic costs)
- decide on preheat window timing and frequency
- smoke test with golden prompts to confirm tail latency before go-live

tara-solutions: Ill prepare the POC runbook (includes load script, warmup commands, rollback steps). Use /infra/presales/runbooks/medstream_poc.md as template.

deploy-bot: presales-smokejob queued for medstream_poc_2026-07-02. ETA 18m.

jordan-sales: Next steps: 1) Ill ask customer for IP ranges + confirm burst cadence, 2) omar will attach pricing lines for standard & premium SLA, 3) helen will attach SOC2 & short checklist, 4) tara + nora will run sandbox smoke test and post results.

helen-security: Ill also include acceptable-dataflow diagram and commit to producing an HSM/KMS timeline if they request customer-managed keys.

omar-pricing: FYI Ill assume $Y/hr for reserved GPUs and $Z/hr for on-demand burst in the quote. If they want the premium SLA, expect ~1.8x reserved rate.

jordan-sales: Perfect, thanks team. Ill update the customer and loop back with answers. :rocket:
